Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Deployment `uploads` in namespace `shop` fills its 64Mi PVC `uploads-data` because its container command writes a 200 MiB file (`dd if=/dev/zero of=/data/uploads.bin bs=1M count=200`) into that volume on startup.
EVIDENCE:
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab logs -n shop deployment/uploads --tail=20`: `dd: error writing '/data/uploads.bin': No space left on device`, then `64+0 records out / 67108864 bytes (64.0MB) copied`, then `uploads: write failed`.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab logs -n shop deployment/uploads --tail=20`: `df -h /data` shows `tmpfs 64.0M 64.0M 0 100% /data`.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop pvc/uploads-data`: `Capacity: 64Mi`, `Status: Bound`, `Used By: uploads-8647dc6f95-wpbml`.
- diag-k8s, `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab describe -n shop deployment/uploads`: the container command is `sh -c "echo uploads: writing; dd if=/dev/zero of=/data/uploads.bin bs=1M count=200; ..."`, mounting claim `uploads-data` at `/data`.
FIX (not applied): Remove the `dd` step from the `uploads` Deployment so it stops writing a 200 MiB dummy file into the 64Mi `uploads-data` claim (or, if real storage is needed, recreate the claim at a size that fits the data).

Fact.Name: cause
Fact.Value: the `uploads` container wrote `uploads.bin` with `dd` until `No space left on device`

Fact.Name: volume
Fact.Value: PV `lab-uploads`, StorageClass `lab-local` (no provisioner: it cannot be expanded)

Fact.Name: fix (not applied)
Fact.Value: free space or move to a larger volume; expansion is not possible with this class
